data.name: Discover Freediving Tour
data.headline: Have you heard about freediving but aren't sure you're ready to take the plunge?
data.description:
**Overview**
Do you love snorkeling but want to start venturing below the surface? If yes, then this is for you! You will learn the basics of freediving, including static breath holds, equalization, and diving techniques from a professional freediving instructor, and then get to immediately put those new skills into action as you explore the amazing sea life of Mission Point Park. 

BASIC SWIMMING ABILITY IS REQUIRED! You will be wearing a buoyant wetsuit, but not life vests, and we will be moving around on the surface and below the surface of the water so you need to know how to swim! You also need to be comfortable in the ocean, as that is where this excursion takes place.

data.booking_notes:
Thank you for booking this Tour with us!

Itinerary:

We will meet at Mission Point Park at 7AM and get geared up. We will start with a short static breath hold session in the shallows where you will learn breath hold techniques that will improve your bottom time and surprise you with what you're capable of! After that we will kick out a little deeper test out some line diving, work on duck dives, and explore some of the local rocky reef. We will be done around 10AM.

Preparation:

Make sure you are well hydrated and rested! These both have a huge impact on your breath hold has well as your ability to clear your ears. It is a good amount of time in the water and you will need your energy! 
**Please take note our waters have cooled off significantly so please plan accordingly for gear. If needed please call the shop to rent. Surf wetsuits ranging from 3mm-4mm are not recommended as we have had people get chilled very early in the tour. If you plan to bring out your own surf suit, a hood, gloves and booties are required as the extremities get cold first and the head gives off the most heat from the body. 

Gear Required:

Wetsuit (A 5mm open cell spearfishing/freediving wetsuit is highly recommended)
Mask / Snorkel
Gloves / Booties
Fins
Weight Belt / Weights

**If you need to rent any of these items you can rent them for an additional cost [here](https://justgetwet.com/products/rental-gear). If rented, we highly recommend coming in a day before to make sure the gear fits properly - otherwise your instructor will grab your rental gear and bring it for you the morning of. **

*Must book at least 24 hours before selected date*

* 2 person minimum to run tour*
